cases.prompt: I have no local GPU. Bring up the generic assistant for the Nemotron Voice Agent using NVIDIA cloud endpoints.
cases.expected_output: Selects the cloud recipe `generic-assistant` (no `/server` or `/single-gpu`), requires only NVIDIA_API_KEY (NVCF), does not run a docker login to nvcr.io, and starts it with `docker compose --profile generic-assistant up -d`.
assertions: Loaded nemotron-voice-agent-deploy/SKILL.md and only the cloud reference.
Chose exactly one recipe: the cloud `generic-assistant` profile.
Required NVIDIA_API_KEY and did not perform an nvcr.io docker login for the cloud recipe.
Did not use HF_TOKEN.

cases.prompt: Deploy the generic assistant on my workstation GPU with local NIM sidecars.
cases.expected_output: Selects `generic-assistant/server`, requires NVIDIA_API_KEY plus an nvcr.io docker login before `up`, and brings it up with `docker compose --profile generic-assistant/server up -d`.
assertions: Selected the `generic-assistant/server` recipe.
Ran the NGC login: docker login nvcr.io with NVIDIA_API_KEY before bringing the stack up.
Did not mix in HF_TOKEN.
Ran commands from the repository root that contains docker-compose.yml.

cases.prompt: Deploy the multilingual assistant on my DGX Spark.
cases.expected_output: Selects `multilingual-assistant/single-gpu`, requires HF_TOKEN, does not use NVIDIA_API_KEY or an nvcr.io login, and completes the single-GPU memory-fit before bringing it up.
assertions: Selected a `*/single-gpu` recipe for DGX Spark rather than `*/server`.
Required HF_TOKEN and did not use NVIDIA_API_KEY or nvcr.io login.
Did not open the server reference for a DGX Spark host.

cases.prompt: Bring up omni-assistant-subagents on my Jetson Thor.
cases.expected_output: Recognizes that omni-assistant-subagents/single-gpu is not supported on Jetson Thor and routes to the cloud recipe `omni-assistant-subagents` instead.
assertions: Identified that omni-assistant-subagents/single-gpu is unsupported on Jetson Thor.
Routed to the cloud `omni-assistant-subagents` recipe as the supported path.
Did not fabricate a single-gpu Thor recipe for subagents.

cases.prompt: My generic-assistant/server deployment fails to pull the NIM sidecar images with a 401 unauthorized. Fix it.
cases.expected_output: Diagnoses a missing or invalid nvcr.io login and re-runs docker login nvcr.io with a valid NVIDIA_API_KEY that has image access, without switching to HF_TOKEN.
assertions: Attributed the 401 to the nvcr.io login / NVIDIA_API_KEY, not to HF_TOKEN.
Recommended docker login nvcr.io with a valid NVIDIA_API_KEY.
Kept the server auth model (did not suggest HF_TOKEN for a `*/server` recipe).

cases.expected_output: Asks "Which profile: `default` (for the browser UI) or `eval` (for evaluation runs such as Tau)?" and waits for the answer before starting anything. It does not choose `default` silently even though it is used when FBA_PROFILE is unset, and it does not run `docker compose ... up` until the user answers.
assertions: Asked which profile to deploy (`default` for the browser UI or `eval` for evaluation runs) and waited for the answer.
Did not choose `default` or `eval` silently.
Did not run any `docker compose --profile frontend-backend-agent... up` command before the user answered.
Did not treat an existing `FBA_PROFILE` in `.env` as the user's choice; if one was present, showed it and asked the user to confirm or change it.
Did not offer or suggest any `tau3_eval*` profile name.

cases.prompt: Deploy the Frontend/Backend Agent on my single-GPU workstation so I can talk to it in the browser UI.
cases.expected_output: Uses the `default` profile without asking about the profile, selects `frontend-backend-agent/single-gpu`, requires HF_TOKEN and NVIDIA_API_KEY as an NVIDIA Inference Hub key, downloads the speech weights, and starts it with `docker compose --profile frontend-backend-agent/single-gpu up -d` without the eval override. After the first browser session it reports `profile=default`, the `generic.yaml` catalog path, and its SHA-256 from the app log.
assertions: Did not ask which profile to use; the request names the browser UI, so it used `default`.
Selected `frontend-backend-agent/single-gpu` and did not pass `docker/docker-compose.fba-eval.yaml`.
Required HF_TOKEN and NVIDIA_API_KEY (Inference Hub key) and did not ask for NVIDIA_SPEECH_API_KEY or an nvcr.io login.
Did not write a `tau3_eval*` value or `FBA_PIPECAT_SETTINGS` to `.env`, and did not overwrite other `.env` keys.
Kept TLS on and pointed the user to `https://<host>:7860`.

cases.prompt: Deploy the Frontend/Backend Agent so I can run a Tau evaluation.
cases.expected_output: Uses the `eval` profile without asking about the profile, selects `frontend-backend-agent/single-gpu`, and starts it with `docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker/docker-compose.fba-eval.yaml --profile frontend-backend-agent/single-gpu up -d`, after `mkdir -p logs`. It does not set FBA_PROFILE in `.env` or edit `core/config/prompts/customer_service.yaml`, and does not set `FBA_PROMPT_PROFILE` or add the silent-frontend overlay. After the first Realtime session it reports `profile=eval`, the `customer_service.yaml` catalog path, and its SHA-256 from the app log.
assertions: Did not ask which profile to use; the request names a Tau evaluation, so it used `eval`.
Used the `frontend-backend-agent/single-gpu` recipe with `-f docker-compose.yml -f docker/docker-compose.fba-eval.yaml`, and did not use the cloud or `/server` recipe for `eval`.
Did not set a `tau3_eval*` profile, did not edit `core/config/prompts/customer_service.yaml`, did not set `FBA_PROMPT_PROFILE`, and did not overwrite other `.env` keys.
Pointed the evaluation client at plain `ws://<host>:7860/v1/realtime` with the model `nvidia/nemotron-realtime-frontend-backend`.
Reported the profile (`eval`), prompt catalog path, and SHA-256 read from the app log after the first session.

cases.prompt: Change the default system prompt for the generic assistant and re-apply it.
cases.expected_output: The deploy skill does not activate because editing prompts is a configuration change handled by nemotron-voice-agent-configure-pipeline, not a deployment.
assertions: Did not load or apply nemotron-voice-agent-deploy.
Recognized this as a configuration change, not a deployment.

cases.prompt: Upgrade pipecat-ai from 1.7.0 to 1.9.0 across this repository.
cases.expected_output: The deploy skill does not activate because a Pipecat version migration is handled by nemotron-voice-agent-upgrade-pipecat.
assertions: Did not load or apply nemotron-voice-agent-deploy.
Recognized this as a Pipecat upgrade task, not a deployment.

cases.prompt: Write a standalone Python script that transcribes a folder of WAV files offline.
cases.expected_output: The deploy skill does not activate because offline batch transcription is not a Nemotron Voice Agent Compose deployment.
assertions: Did not load or apply nemotron-voice-agent-deploy.
Recognized this as offline batch STT unrelated to deploying the voice agent.
